title: Variant orchestration for metric compactness
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Synthesize a variant orchestration strategy and updated Figma library for the new compact metric cards and related rollouts. This ticket covers token mappings, component variants, responsive behavior, and a migration plan to replace ad-hoc compact styles currently used across dashboard views and cost explorer. Goal: single source of truth for compact metrics that supports canary rollouts, animation/state transitions, and accessibility contrast levels.
background: Several dashboard teams implemented bespoke compact metric cards to fit dense views (cost explorer, model rollout list, usage timeline). That approach diverged on spacing, elevation, and status pill behavior leading to inconsistent density and confusing rollouts. PMs want a single, configurable variant system so product teams can toggle compactness without hacking CSS. Requires token alignment, Figma component refactor, and a rollout playbook for Console releases.
acceptance_criteria: Figma component set (MetricCard) includes: default, compact, compact-condensed, and compact-with-avatar variants
Token map documented: spacing, font-scaling, elevation, pill sizes for each variant
Example pages in Figma demonstrating responsive switch at 720px and 480px breakpoints
Accessibility audit: all variants pass AA color contrast and keyboard focus ordering
Migration guide for engineering with CSS variable names and fallback tokens
Rollout plan defined with canary gates and metrics to monitor (visual regression rate, layout shift, support tickets)
tasks: Audit existing compact metric implementations across Console surfaces
Author token mapping doc with proposed names and migration aliases
Design Figma component variants and interactive prototype for handoff
Run accessibility pass and update contrast tokens where needed
Create engineering handoff: tokens JSON, CSS var names, example markup
Draft rollout plan: canary cohort, visual diff thresholds, rollback criteria
decisions: Use a single MetricCard component rather than separate compact components
Introduce token prefix md.metric.* for medium density and cn.metric.* for compact/condensed
Support two compact flavors: compact (65% vertical padding) and compact-condensed (40% padding + truncated labels)
Avoid changing metric value font weight across variants to reduce perceived drift in dashboards
Use motion-safe fold for compact expand/collapse to prevent layout shift during rollouts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Existing ad-hoc styles may break pages if tokens are removed. Mitigation: maintain alias tokens for 3 releases and provide migration script
Risk: Compact variants could reduce readability on older monitors. Mitigation: enforce AA contrast and add tooltip for truncated labels
Risk: Rollout visual diffs triggering false positives. Mitigation: include manual review step for top-10 critical dashboards during canary
notes: Prototype feedback from PM (Jonah Patel): prefer clear canary switch in Console release toggles and telemetry for ticket correlation
Engineering review (Riley Chen): asked to provide CSS variable fallback for non-CSS-in-JS pages; added to handoff tasks
Design review (Sofia Alvarez): recommended microcopy for compact-condensed to show full label on hover
Design critique session 2026-03-05: consensus to keep pill size consistent across density variants but adjust internal padding
open_questions: Should compact-condensed support multi-line values or always truncate on second line?
What telemetry event schema should engineering emit to signal which variant was rendered? (suggestion: ds.metric.variant)
Do we need a server-side flag to force compact rendering for exported PDFs?
